title: Duck King Arena
description: Waddle into a hilarious cartoon showdown—train, gear up, and battle quirky rival ducks to claim the golden crown of the pond.
controls: Tap action buttons and upgrades to train your duck fighter and defeat every challenger.

zh-CN.title: 最强鸭王
zh-CN.description: 爆笑魔性竞技最强鸭王：武装你的战斗鸭一路过关斩将、爆锤奇葩对手鸭，霸气登顶池塘最强鸭王宝座！
zh-CN.controls: 升级强化战斗鸭装备与招式，点击出击击败各路对手冲击最强鸭王。
